results.question: Does Webtechnosys develop mobile applications?
results.answer: Yes, Webtechnosys develops mobile applications as part of their AI-powered software development services in India. They provide custom software development including mobile app development for businesses across Mumbai, Goa, Bengaluru, and Gurugram.

results.question: Does Webtechnosys build custom software for Indian companies?
results.answer: Yes, Webtechnosys builds custom software for Indian companies. They provide AI, web, mobile application, and custom software development services across India, supporting clients with structured project management and dedicated support during Indian business hours.

results.question: What AI automation services are available?
results.answer: AI Automation services at Webtechnosys have been merged into its broader AI Solutions offering. For detailed options or custom AI automation tailored to your business, you can discuss your specific needs with the team.

results.question: What hospitality AI solutions does Webtechnosys offer?
results.answer: Webtechnosys offers hospitality AI solutions including HotelRADAR Frontdesk, Booking Engine, Hotel PMS, and Channel Manager. These products focus on practical AI adoption for hospitality businesses, addressing front desk operations, property management, and channel coordination.

results.question: What is HotelRADAR?
results.answer: HotelRADAR is a practical AI-powered solution developed for independent hotels, resorts, and villas that focuses on market awareness, guest psychology, and direct booking. It combines modern AI tools to help these businesses understand and serve their customers better.

results.question: Does Webtechnosys provide AI training?
results.answer: Yes, Webtechnosys offers AI training programs including a practical one-day AI Tool Universe Bootcamp and a Corporate In-House AI Skill Program tailored for companies seeking practical AI adoption and team training. These programs focus on applied AI skills, workflow experiments, and business-relevant projects.

results.question: How can I book the AI Tool Universe Bootcamp?
results.answer: You can book a seat for the AI Tool Universe Bootcamp online via the Webtechnosys training booking page. Choose a cohort day (Saturday cohorts in September and October 2026 are available), provide your details, and complete the payment of ₹1,650 through Razorpay. Confirmation and venue details are shared after payment verification.

results.question: Does Webtechnosys create AI films or commercial videos?
results.answer: Yes, Webtechnosys creates AI films and commercial videos in Goa, specializing in cinematic AI filmmaking for hotels, resorts, tourism brands, properties, and local businesses. They work from actual property footage to craft storytelling content that enhances hospitality marketing.

results.question: Who founded Webtechnosys?
results.answer: Webtechnosys was founded by Manish Purohit.

results.answer: Yes, Webtechnosys serves hotels and resorts by providing AI solutions tailored for hospitality businesses, including demand intelligence, leakage control, AI automation, and direct-booking support for independent hotels, resorts, and villas in India.
